verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਕੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਕੀ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jeko aap ganai kai paatisaahaa(n) te aakee hovai|

en.bdb: If soemeone in his pride stands opposed to the king, he is killed

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਇ ਕਤਲਾਮੁ ਹਰਾਮੁਖੋਰ ਕਾਣੁ ਨ ਖਫਣੁ ਚਿਤਾ ਨ ਟੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hui katalaam haraamukhor kaan na khafan chitaa na Tovai|

en.bdb: And considering him a bastard pyre, coffin or grave are not available to him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਟਕਸਾਲਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘੜੈ ਖੋਟੈਹਾਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: Takasaalahu baahar ghaRai khoTaihaaraa janam vigovai|

en.bdb: Out side the mint one who is coining fake coins is losing his life in vain , (because when caught he will be punished ).

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਿਬਾਸੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨੁਕਸਾਨੀ ਅੰਝੂ ਰੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: libaasee furamaan likh hoi nukasaanee a(n)jhoo rovai|

en.bdb: Giver of the false commands also weeps tearfully when caught.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਦੜ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੁਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gidhaR dhee kar saahibee bol kubol na abichal hovai|

en.bdb: A jackal pretending to be a lion may ,pose to be a commander but cannot hide his true howl (and is caught).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਗਦਹਿ ਚੜ੍ਹੈ ਰਾਉ ਪੜੇ ਵੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਧੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: muh kaalai gadheh chaRhai raau paRe vee bhariaa dhovai|

en.bdb: Similarly, the tier when caught is made to mount the ass and dust is thrown on his head . He washes himself in his tears.
This way, the man absorbed in the duality reaches the wrong place.
